title: Estimator program cost components
statement: Let $n\in\mathbb{N}$, let $f:\{-1,1\}^n\to\{-1,1\}$ be a Boolean function, let $\mathcal{F}$ be a nonempty finite family of subsets of $\{0,\ldots,n-1\}$, and let $0<\varepsilon\le 1/2$ be rational. For every outcome in the support of the estimator program's output-and-cost distribution, the number of random examples is $|\mathcal{F}|M$, the number of queries is zero, and the work is $|\mathcal{F}|M+|\mathcal{F}|M(n+1)$, where $M$ is the program's prescribed number of samples per coefficient.
hypotheses_covered: $\mathcal{F}$ is a finite nonempty family of subsets of $\{0,\ldots,n-1\}$
The outcome belongs to the support of the estimator program's output-and-cost distribution
